text:
ben: Heads up - release promo is blocked, deploy-scheduler queue is backing up and artifact staging is hung for pipeline #84321. seeing repeated worker timeouts + multipart upload stalls.

deploy-bot: promotion_hold: pipeline 84321 auto-paused due to staging timeout (reason: artifact-staging-lag). See /ops/releases for details. :warning:

ada: ETA? we need to decide pin vs wait. change window at 22:00 UTC today if we want manual promote.

carla: digging in infra - S3 multipart uploads to eu-west-1 are failing with 503s from the edge. uploads stuck at part 0/5 for the build artifacts. suspect upstream S3 region degradation + our concurrent uploader throttle. logs: 

```
> 2026-02-10T19:03:11Z deploy-uploader: upload-part failed status=503 uploadId=3f2b... part=0 retries=2
> aws s3api list-multipart-uploads --bucket rwd-artifacts --prefix pipeline/84321 -> shows uploadId 3f2b... (stuck)
```

carla: temp mitigation options: abort stuck uploads and restart in eu-central-1, or rerun pipeline with single-part upload fallback. abort command ready: `aws s3api abort-multipart-upload --bucket rwd-artifacts --key pipeline/84321/obj --upload-id 3f2b...`

dave: QA side - we also have a flaky integration on staging that started failing on the new image (timeout in analytics worker). If we manual-promote the last-good image we reduce risk. rolling forward with current build may reintroduce the flake.

eva: confirmed - e2e flaky happened 6/6 times against latest tag. last-good tag `release-20260209-556` passes reliably in staging.

ben: can we do manual promote of last-good then re-run failing pipeline async? prefer manual promote + pin. if infra wants to abort uploads now i'll do promote.

deploy-bot: promotion_attempt: blocked: cache-metadata-mismatch between registry and index, promotion will not proceed until artifact metadata matches expected checksum.

ada: decision: pin to `release-20260209-556` for promo to prod. open rollback PR for current commit, add note to release_notes: "manual pin due to artifact staging lag and flaky e2e on new image". schedule follow-up for 2 hours after change window to retry pipeline.

carla: executing abort + restart plan now. aborting multipart upload and reuploading artifact to eu-central-1 as fallback. command: `aws s3api abort-multipart-upload --bucket rwd-artifacts --key pipeline/84321/obj --upload-id 3f2b... && rwdctl uploader --region eu-central-1 --single-part upload ./artifact.tar.gz --dest pipeline/84321/obj`

dave: i'll open the rollback PR and add a changelog entry + note for support to notify customers. PR title: "rollback: pin prod to release-20260209-556 (staging artifact stall)"

ben: after carla confirms successful reupload we'll re-run the pipeline but do not auto-promote. manual promote only after we validate e2e in staging.

ada: change window set: 2026-02-10T22:00Z -> 2026-02-10T23:00Z. ops notify: @sales @support @growth.

eva: QA will run a focused smoke + analytics-worker e2e once staging has the reuploaded artifact. ping me when done.

carla: reupload successful to eu-central-1, checksum matches. `sha256: b6e2...`

deploy-bot: promotion_unblock_signal: artifact metadata reconciled for pipeline 84321. manual promotion still required by release leads.

ben: acknowledged. I'll wait for QA signoff then run `rwdctl promote --image gcr.io/redwood/release:release-20260209-556 --env prod --note "manual pin - artifact staging fallback"`

ada: thanks team, good triage. action items: carla - post incident ticket for S3 region degradation; dave - open rollback PR and changelog; ben - hold on promote until QA signoff; eva - confirm smoke results. we'll reconvene at 21:50 UTC to decide final promote. :thumbsup:
